title: Buyer Deadlines Under the Home Purchase Agreement: Rescission and Financing Windows
content:
Every Home Purchase Agreement runs on a set of buyer deadlines counted from the contract date. The figures below differ by collection; the rules that apply them belong to the agreement's rescission and financing terms.

| Collection | Rescission window (business days) | Full loan application (calendar days) | Outside-lender written loan approval (calendar days) | Cash proof of funds (calendar days) | Financing contingency (calendar days) | Refund on loan denial (% of refundable deposits) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pathway Collection | 3 | 5 | 21 | 5 | 30 | 100 |
| Meadow Collection | 3 | 5 | 21 | 5 | 30 | 100 |
| Heritage Collection | 3 | 5 | 21 | 5 | 30 | 100 |
| Crestview Collection | 3 | 5 | 21 | 5 | 30 | 100 |
| Summit Collection | 3 | 7 | 30 | 3 | 45 | 100 |
| Reserve Collection | 3 | 7 | 30 | 3 | 45 | 100 |

## What each figure means for the buyer

- **Rescission window**: the business days after the contract date within which the buyer may rescind with a full refund.
- **Full loan application**: the calendar days after the contract date by which a financed buyer must complete a full loan application.
- **Outside-lender written loan approval**: the calendar days after the contract date by which a buyer financing with an outside lender must deliver a written loan approval.
- **Cash proof of funds**: the calendar days after the contract date by which a cash buyer must deliver proof of funds.
- **Financing contingency**: the calendar days after the contract date within which a written loan denial lets the buyer cancel with a refund.
- **Refund on loan denial**: the percent of refundable earnest money returned on a cancellation for loan denial, 100 in every collection.

## Reading the table

The Summit Collection and Reserve Collection give the buyer 7 calendar days for the full loan application, 30 for an outside-lender written approval and 45 for the financing contingency, but only 3 calendar days for a cash buyer's proof of funds. The other four collections give 5, 21, 30 and 5 respectively. The rescission window is 3 business days in every collection.
